commands.review_summary:
The branch adds no-op stdout/stderr error listeners to codex-supervisor's stdio JsonRpcClient and adds a mocked Vitest regression around the production endpoint connector.

PR surface: Source +2, Tests +62. Total +64 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main attaches stdout/stderr data listeners on the stdio child without error listeners, and Node EventEmitter error events throw when unhandled. I did not run a live codex-supervisor repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Contributor action is needed for current real behavior proof and the branch also needs a small test type fix; ClawSweeper should not repair this automatically while the proof gate remains unsatisfied.

target.title: fix(codex-supervisor): suppress unhandled stdout/stderr stream errors in JsonRpcClient
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`JsonRpcClient.start()` attaches `data` listeners to `this.proc.stdout` and `this.proc.stderr`, but does not attach `error` listeners. If either stream emits an `error` event, the unhandled error can crash the OpenClaw process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add no-op `error` handlers to both stdout and stderr streams. Stream read errors are treated as non-fatal because the process `error`/`close` handlers already report the real outcome.

Same pattern as cxbAsDev #100522 (merged).

## Changes

- **`extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.ts`** — add `this.proc.stdout.on("error", () => {})` and `this.proc.stderr.on("error", () => {})` (2 lines)

## Evidence

```bash
node --import tsx/esm scripts/proof/codex-supervisor-stream-errors.mts
```

```
==============================================================
Proof: stream error handlers in JsonRpcClient
==============================================================

Test: Simulating codex-supervisor child with stream errors
  exit code: 1
  stdout: "{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true}}"
  stderr lines: 1
  ✅ PASS: Process did not crash on stream errors

==============================================================
✅ PROOF PASSED — JsonRpcClient handles stream errors safely
==============================================================
```
